research_question: Can Badger's reported hybrid advantage be tested against KelinciWCA with identical total CPU, wall-clock, cost metric and held-out Java programs?
hypothesis: If original code and dependencies can be pinned and the same cost metric observed in both arms, an independent paired resource-fair experiment is feasible at bounded cost.

repositories.readme_build: ant build after JPF core/SPF setup; Badger's symbolic-execution part alone
make for native AFL interface and gradle build for Java instrumentor; AFL required

dependency_evidence: Badger README references JPF core nolleryc commit 0f2f2901cd0ae9833145c38fee57be03da90a64f and Symbolic PathFinder jpf-symbc commit b64ab6a0c8dde218b34969b46ee526ece7ddee44, plus Z3. Evaluation scripts are present but do not establish cross-arm CPU parity.

observed_environment.host_java_runtime: unavailable; java -version reports Unable to locate a Java Runtime

actual_check: Public repositories cloned into disposable /private/tmp/badger-feas-XDqnXq for inspection; git SHA and pre-2019 commits checked; host and one offline disposable container tool inventory checked. No Badger, KelinciWCA, JPF/SPF or AFL component was built or run; no cost-input output measured.
observed_information_contribution: The proposed first action found that source availability is not the blocking condition; 2018-era dependency/build reproducibility and CPU/cost-metric alignment are. This is an observed planning/feasibility result, not a validated Paper 4 information-gain prediction.
next_gate: Only attempt a bounded build in an isolated pinned container with compatible Java, Ant, Gradle, AFL, JPF core/SPF and Z3; compare one known-cost input across arms before scheduling any paired experiment. If dependency/bootstrap cost exceeds the local experiment budget, record no-go and redirect to a cheaper observable lead.
uncertainty: Build compatibility, Java version, exact JPF/SPF dependencies, pinned AFL instrumentation, cost-counter equivalence and per-subject CPU fairness remain unverified. The existing JDK21 container may not be compatible with 2018 JPF code.
paper4_validation_status: one planned feasibility action partially executed with a negative environment result; predicted entropy gain and action ranking remain uncalibrated and were not compared against an observed baseline action
